messages:
sarah (AE): Quick sync — ShieldHealth RFP follow-up. They want tenant isolation, throughput pinning for Dedicated, KMS/HSM details, and a one-week staging POC that requires network peering. Need owners for answers and attachments. cc @nidhi @mike

mike (solutions): I'll take throughput pinning + capacity numbers. They listed 'A100x8 equivalent' in the RFP — can we commit that profile for the POC?

nidhi (security): I'll handle the security questionnaire and KMS/HSM responses. Need the latest compliance attachments (ISO/FedRAMP summary). @ashwin can you share our hybrid HSM diagram?

ashwin (eng-sre): Uploaded diagram link: https://redwood.s3/diagrams/hsm-hybrid-v2.pdf. For tenant isolation: VPC per-customer + dedicated fleet option. Short blurb for RFP: "VPC peering + private control plane, optional dedicated capacity pools with network isolation and ACLs."

legal-bot: Reminder: do not share customer data in public links. Use secure share for signed agreements and the filled questionnaire. :lock:

sarah (AE): ShieldHealth wants a pricing ballpark ASAP — they're estimating ~100M tokens/mo and require 95th percentile latency SLO of 120ms. Mike, can you post a quick cost calc and an example reserved-capacity config?

mike (solutions): Ballpark numbers & assumptions incoming. For hosted + Optimize we assume model family X small-quantized. Initial rough calc: ~ $0.018/token effective is wrong — redoing. Attaching spreadsheet with two scenarios (hosted vs dedicated).

mike (solutions): Attachment: https://redwood.s3/pricing/shieldhealth-100M-estimate.xlsx

ashwin (eng-sre): For throughput pinning we recommend reserved pod assignment. Example config snippet for ops team to provision:
```yaml
pod_type: reserved
count: 4
gpu: a100x8
throughput_pin: 1200rps
priority: customer-dedicated
```
This should meet 95th=120ms for their short-prompt workload. Will verify after testplan.

nidhi (security): Security answers (high level):
- KMS: Customer-managed keys supported via BYOK (KMS) and HSM wraps.
- HSM: Integration via PKCS#11-backed HSM partners, FIPS validated modules available.
- Audit logs: Token-level and API auditing available for 90 days by default (extendable).
I'll upload the completed questionnaire PDF.

nidhi (security): Attachment: https://redwood.s3/security/shield-qna-filled.pdf

sarah (AE): Timeline note — they want the POC week starting Apr 6. Ops needs ~48 hours to provision peering + reserved pods. Who can provision and confirm window?

ashwin (eng-sre): I can schedule provisioning Apr 4-5. I need their cloud account ID, peer CIDR, and whether they prefer AWS transit gateway or VPC peering (us-west-2). Also require an IPsec PSK if they want site-to-site.

mike (solutions): For POC acceptance tests I propose: 1) throughput smoke (sustained RPS), 2) latency regression vs baseline, 3) cost-per-1k tokens measurement, 4) correctness sample set. I'll draft a short test plan.

mike (solutions): Test plan draft: https://redwood.s3/pocs/shield-poc-testplan-v1.md

sarah (AE): Owners for delivery: mike -> pricing & test plan, nidhi -> security Qs & PDF, ashwin -> peering & provisioning, sarah -> customer comms and packaging. Any blockers?

ashwin (eng-sre): Only blocker: potential CIDR overlap. We saw their initial CIDR 10.20.0.0/16 which conflicts with our staging 10.20.0.0/16. Need them to choose a non-overlapping range. Also need expected concurrent connections to size NAT/gateway.

customer-bot: ShieldHealth network contact submitted: amy@shieldhealth.com; requested CIDR 10.20.0.0/16; preferred region us-west-2; request peering + routing table updates.

ashwin (eng-sre): CIDR overlaps with our staging cluster. I'll DM them to request a different /16 or use a /20.

nidhi (security): One more compliance note: we require an executed NDA before providing keys or access to PII in logs. Sales/legal to confirm NDA signed.

sarah (AE): Noted — I'll escalate legal. Thanks team :trophy: I'll consolidate attachments and send the package back to ShieldHealth by EOD.

mike (solutions): I'll update the spreadsheet with two scenarios (monthly reserved vs burst) and include an estimated committed spend line.

ashwin (eng-sre): Once CIDR is resolved I can book the provisioning window and open a runbook ticket.

sarah (AE): Perfect. Closing loop after legal confirms NDA. If anyone adds new attachments, drop links in this thread.
